verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs state that it supports browsing commit history and code files. A community report confirms that non-contributors read source through the web UI instead of cloning. The pack has no evidence of line-by-line blame, one of the story's three required parts. Missing for 10: documented line-by-line blame view, in-depth docs on the file and history browser UI.

support.subject: As a developer, I can browse repository files, commit history, and line-by-line blame in the web interface
